key_insight: Combining Neural Prophet with a Deep Neural Network (NP-DNN) improves stock price forecasting by capturing both classical time-series components (trend/seasonality/uncertainty) and complex nonlinear patterns, yielding more accurate point forecasts and tighter probabilistic intervals.
problem_solved: Addresses the inability of traditional statistical time-series methods to effectively model nonlinear dynamics and reliably estimate the probability range (prediction intervals) of future stock prices.
method: Use Neural Prophet as a backbone to model trend, seasonality, holidays and provide probabilistic forecasts (prediction intervals).
Integrate a Deep Neural Network to learn nonlinear relationships and interactions from historical prices and engineered features.
Fuse outputs (or train end-to-end) so NP’s interpretable components and DNN’s nonlinear representations jointly produce final point forecasts and uncertainty estimates.
impact: Enables AI/ML practitioners to produce more reliable, risk-aware stock forecasts that combine interpretability with nonlinear modeling power—useful for trading systems, risk management, and other time-series domains requiring uncertainty quantification.
visual_elements: Architecture diagram: NP block (trend/seasonality/uncertainty) + DNN block feeding a fusion layer → final forecast with intervals.
Forecast plot: historical price, predicted mean, and shaded prediction intervals vs actuals to show interval calibration.
Benchmark bar chart: performance (MAE/RMSE/interval coverage) of NP-DNN vs baseline models (ARIMA, Prophet, pure DNN).
Feature/attention visualization: heatmap or importance scores showing which inputs drive nonlinear DNN corrections.
paper_title: Stock Market Price Prediction using Neural Prophet with Deep Neural Network
paper_authors: Navin Chhibber, Suneel Khemka, Navneet Kumar Tyagi, Rohit Tewari, Bireswar Banerjee
